    25	
    26	import sys
    27	
    28	class RTLD_for_MKL():
    29	    def __init__(self):
    30	        self.saved_rtld = None
    31	
    32	    def __enter__(self):
    33	        import ctypes
    34	        try:
    35	            self.saved_rtld = sys.getdlopenflags()
    36	            # python loads libraries with RTLD_LOCAL, but MKL requires RTLD_GLOBAL
    37	            # pre-load MKL with RTLD_GLOBAL before loading the native extension
    38	            sys.setdlopenflags(self.saved_rtld | ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    39	        except AttributeError:
    40	            pass
    41	        del ctypes
    42	
    43	    def __exit__(self, *args):
    44	        if self.saved_rtld:
    45	            sys.setdlopenflags(self.saved_rtld)
    46	            self.saved_rtld = None
    47	
    48	with RTLD_for_MKL():
    49	    from . import _mklinit
    50	
    51	del RTLD_for_MKL
    52	del sys
    53	
    54	from ._py_mkl_service import *
    55	
    56	
    57	__version__ = '2.4.0'
